abstract: Project-aware OpenCode hook scaffolder that verifies the live official OpenCode plugin, config, SDK, custom-tools, and troubleshooting docs; audits a target repository in detail; inspects existing project and global OpenCode plugin state; and then generates deterministic TypeScript-only `.opencode/plugins/` scaffolds, defaulting to a minimal lifecycle/action plugin with visible TUI feedback, repo-owned scripts, controlled automatic follow-up, optional broad hook-surface stubs, and dependency/config merges only when needed.
